expectations.text: The response does not misclassify the 503 as the exact Safari Notification stale-client case or recommend the special Update and reload path.
expectations.evidence: 503 is not routed to the special stale-client Update and reload path.

expectations.text: The response rejects an automatic or blind reload and preserves the unsaved form input.
expectations.evidence: Unsaved input is preserved and reload is avoided.

expectations.text: The response gives a bounded, non-destructive diagnostic or retry next step appropriate to a transient network/chunk failure.
expectations.evidence: Response gives a bounded retry or diagnostic next step.
